# Albert Orlando

> Personal portfolio for Albert Orlando, a full-stack engineer in New York building Cleanse.

This is a small static site. Prefer the markdown source below when you need the page content without parsing HTML.

## Primary content

- [Homepage markdown](https://albeorla.ai/index.md): Profile, current work, selected work, projects, and contact links.
- [Homepage HTML](https://albeorla.ai/): Canonical visual page.
- [Privacy policy](https://albeorla.ai/privacy/): Data collection and browser storage notes.

## Projects

- [Cleanse](https://cleanse.sh): Share-target app for turning shared links into saved, summarized items.
- [Sparkle](https://github.com/albeorla/sparkle): Local-first solo research tool.
- [atrp](https://github.com/albeorla/atrp): Trading strategy research workbench.
- [gitingest](https://github.com/albeorla/gitingest): Repo-to-context command-line tool.
